deploy-bot: Deploy v3.4.0-miniwave -> eu-west-1 complete. Running miniwave-smoke (6 probes) https://deploys.redwood/status/1768876543 :rocket:
marta: seeing 2/6 failing - kv-prefill returning 429s (rate limit) and one embed p95 up to 900ms
luke: 429s not 503s - might be our new inflight limiter kicking in during prefill warmup. Could be transient. change window til 23:00 UTC, prefer throttling tweak over rollback
sre-jay: checking limiter metrics on eu-w-1c, spike in per-host concurrency and 429 counter correlated with prefill warmups
sre-jay: action: temporarily raise prefill inflight limit from 50->70 on eu-w-1 hosts to dampen warmup bursts
marta: applied change to configmap for prefill limiter in eu-west-1. re-running miniwave-smoke
deploy-bot: re-run results: 5/6 pass, 429s cleared, embed p95 now ~320ms :white_check_mark:
release-coordinator: filing RN-5418: "postdeploy: prefill inflight limiter sensitivity during warmup (v3.4.0-miniwave)". PM to triage tomorrow
luke: leaving soft-hold on change window for 30m. If metrics stay stable we'll remove temporary limit and ramp to full gradually
sre-jay: collecting allocator and inflight traces into OPS-1305 for root-cause; will include heap/burst profiles
marta: thanks team. prefer this transient throttling change over rolling back. ping this thread if anything degrades and we'll decide rollback
